title: OpenCode
description: OpenCode as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on your own OpenCode over ACP with Tomrade's tools, a ticket can also go to OpenCode in a terminal, its own sessions report to Tomrade once connected, and its providers answer Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Connecting OpenCode adds a tomrade server to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json and writes Tomrade's reporting plugin to ~/.config/opencode/plugins/tomrade.js; a background call keeps its one-call config in a temporary folder. It reads OpenCode's own session database (~/.local/share/opencode) to show an ended session's conversation.
why.exec: Runs your own `opencode` command: `opencode acp` for conversations, `opencode models` to list its models, and `opencode run` for background calls.
